opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 for research; in special cases, and by prior agreement, up to £750,000; most grants awarded are below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based institutions/organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution for at least the duration of the project; projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organisation; projects led by schools or further education colleges; projects led by undergraduates or master's students; PhD fees or projects mainly to support a PhD; establishment of academic posts; dissemination-only projects; local charities or statutory replacement. In exceptional cases overseas organisations may be accepted if no UK host is feasible, with strong UK-focused dissemination, engagement and impact plans.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions from its Strategic Review, aiming to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn, exact dates announced in advance). Outline application deadline: 5 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society, supporting research on racial diversity within the UK. 2026 priority theme: Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
